links.outcome: Human-AI team performance with AI aid versus standalone accuracy, including overreliance
links.effect: Clinical validity depended on the human–AI team's adversarial resilience rather than standalone accuracy; trainees showed automation bias with a high-reliability model while experts gained little.
links.quote: We operationalize systemic resilience as the capacity to maintain diagnostic integrity under algorithmic failure and demonstrate that clinical validity depends on the human–AI team’s adversarial resilience rather than standalone accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Open-source educational sandbox to inoculate clinicians against automated errors (deskilling/never-skilling mitigation)

screen.reason: This study is an empirical multi-reader crossover study assessing clinician-AI collaboration, specifically testing how clinician oversight behaves under high-reliability vs. error-injected AI conditions to evaluate automation bias and systemic resilience.
